# `m.stocks.movers`

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

The twenty US stocks with the largest percentage move today, up or down.

```python
m.stocks.movers(direction, *, include_otc=False)
```

[All datasets](README.md)

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Verbs | `fetch()`, `poll()` |
| Served by | REST |
| `poll()` | `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`: holds exactly the latest cycle's rows, keyed by `Symbol`; `mode=dm.PollMode.APPEND` also keys by `Updated` |

## Arguments

What each argument does for this dataset, and the rule it follows for every dataset that takes it.

| Argument | For this dataset | For every dataset |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `direction` | `dm.Direction.GAINERS` or `dm.Direction.LOSERS`. |  |
| `include_otc` | True to include OTC securities. |  |

## Plan access

Which of Massive's plans include this dataset, how recent its data is on each, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Top Market Movers (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| Stocks Basic | Not included |
| Stocks Starter | 15-minute delayed |
| Stocks Developer | 15-minute delayed |
| Stocks Advanced | Real-time |
| Stocks Business | Real-time |
